text: Widened the asset glob in scripts/check-bundle-size.js from dist/assets/*.js to cover .js, .mjs and .cjs, and made an empty match set exit 1 with `no bundle output found under dist/assets` instead of reporting a 0.00 KB pass. MAX_BUNDLE_KB is now parsed with Number() and validated as a positive finite number at startup, exiting 1 and naming the variable when it is not. The per-file report prints one line per matched file and an explicit overage line when the total exceeds the ceiling. Updated scripts/__tests__/check-bundle-size.test.js to cover the empty-directory, bad-ceiling and over-ceiling paths. No change to the ceiling value, the Vite config, or any workflow.
